values: ✓ = at least one historical product is exposed by CDS; × = unavailable in CDS constraints

Availability Matrix uses ✓/× for a quick model-by-variable view. Resolution Matrix distinguishes M (monthly), D (daily), F (fixed), and combinations such as M+D. A ✓ is a CDS catalogue-level result; it does not guarantee that all variables share one r*i*p*f* member. The Variable Dictionary maps CDS names to CMIP6 variable IDs. Total soil moisture (mrso) and leaf area index (lai) are not exposed in the current CDS form and must be obtained directly from ESGF.
